description: The ASRAI PLAN: a ready LONG-TERM investing basket (not trading) for someone who wants to invest but doesn't know how to build a portfolio — use for 'build me a portfolio', 'what should I invest in long term', 'I have $X, what do I buy'. Built every quarter by AI from Asrai's own data and the Model portfolio: it chooses the narratives with real money flowing in and, in each, the coin that can gain the most, with one coin per narrative. BTC and ETH are the base; the rest are Strong (proven earners) or Gem (smaller, little noticed, money flowing in). Checked every week for serious problems. The market state sets the split: bull 50% BTC+ETH, sideways 70%, bear 80%, risky (BTC dominance under 45 or altcoin index 75+) 30% BTC+ETH, 10% alts, 60% cash. Returns the state, weights (USD when `amount` is given), each coin's narrative and reason, and real results since launch. Be honest: AI picks can't be backtested, alts rarely beat BTC, gems can fall to almost nothing, drops of 70%+ happened. Not financial advice; follow it at asrai.me/portfolio/plan. Answer with the plan, and adjust only for the user's money, risk or number of coins. Don't describe past plan changes or compare it with other portfolios unless asked. Never name a person.

amount.description: Optional amount in USD to split by the plan's weights
